workflow_runs.display_title: feat(process-hardening): add config-gated pre-main hardening opt-out

head_commit.message:
feat(process-hardening): add config-gated pre-main hardening opt-out

- Add `[security].process_hardening_disable` in config types/schema/docs.
- Update `codex-process-hardening` to read this flag before applying
  hardening.
- Keep secure default behavior: hardening remains enabled unless explicitly
  disabled.
- Add unit tests for missing/invalid/true/false config handling.
- Intentionally read only `${CODEX_HOME}/config.toml` (home-level), not
  repo/project config layers, to avoid untrusted-repo config injection.

This enables dev/test workflows (e.g. debugger/ASan/LSan attach behavior).
